**Verdict: DROP_EVERYTHING**  
**Practical Recommendation:** Drive to Steamboat Thursday evening and ski both Friday and Saturday, taking one PTO day. 

### Why This is Exceptional
Thursday’s mountain closure created a rare scenario: 14 inches of storm snow accumulated unskied, topped by 6 inches overnight. Friday morning opens on a **20-inch untouched reset**. 

Because patrol releases are staged throughout Friday morning, you will benefit from rolling rope drops on a weekday crowd footprint. Steamboat’s signature glades (Shadows, Closets) will ski deep and buoyant, while expert steeps—such as the Chutes and Christmas Tree Bowl—should open as mitigation finishes. 

Rather than a single powder day, this is a stacked two-day sequence: Friday night recharges the mountain with another **12 inches of opening snow** (plus 2 inches during Saturday skiing). Sustained sub-freezing temperatures will protect snow quality, and moderate ridge gusts (15–18 mph) will not threaten major lift operations.

### Logistics & Budget
* **Access:** The road approach is confirmed. Take I-70 to Silverthorne, CO-9 to Kremmling, and US-40 over Rabbit Ears Pass. Carry chains/traction-law compliance for pass crossings.
* **Cost:** With your Ikon Pass covering access, two nights of lodging at the estimated ~$180/night totals roughly $360—well under your ~$800 reference benchmark for an exceptional multi-day run. 

### What Would Change the Plan
* **Road Closures:** Rabbit Ears Pass (US-40) can close during heavy snow cycles. If the pass shuts Thursday evening, do not wait it out on the road; pivot to Winter Park (via Berthoud Pass) or Copper Mountain on Friday, monitoring CDOT (cotrip.org) for a delayed Steamboat push.
* **Severe Mitigation Delays:** If upper mountain avalanche safety holds the gondola and upper chairs closed past mid-day Friday, lap lower-mountain trees (e.g., lower Storm Peak/Pony Express areas) and rely on Saturday morning’s 12-inch dump for the full upper-mountain release.
* **Early Exit Option:** If Saturday weekend crowds materialize quickly or upper gates remain unexpectedly throttled, depart after Friday’s reset for a cheap, high-reward single-night trip.
